বিসিএস জব সল্যুশন.question: ২২) If the length of each of the sides of three square garden plots is increased by 50 percent by what percent is the sum of the areas of the three plots increased?
বিসিএস জব সল্যুশন.exp:
Question: If the length of each of the sides of three square garden plots is increased by 50 percent by what percent is the sum of the areas of the three plots increased?

Solution:
Let,
Side of a square garden = 100
So, area = (100)2 = 10000
Sum of the area of 3 square garden = 3 × 10000 = 30000
After 50% increase side of a square becomes = (100 + 50% of 100) = 150

So, area = 1502 = 22500
Area of 3 square = 22500 × 3 = 67500
Area increases = (67500 - 30000) = 37500
So, percentage of increase = (37500 × 100)/30000 = 125%

Telephone for the fire brigade and meanwhile help the inmates out be the most useful thing to do, first of all, if you see your neighbour's house on fire.
